description: Representative official local22_pbc workflow with the robust SR preset; energy is the Monte Carlo estimate in the sampled Sz=0 sector.
rng_note: No fixed seed was supplied; new runs need not reproduce individual Monte Carlo samples.
exact_check_note: The final checkpoint was contracted by a separate exhaustive Sz=0 enumerator; CSV energies and gradient norms are the per-iteration Monte Carlo estimates.
missing_mcse_note: NaN energy_error is preserved as unavailable MCSE and omitted from the uncertainty band.
plot_command: python3 plot/workflow/plot_energy_trajectory.py --csv tutorials/assets/energy_trajectory_2x2_pbc.csv --out tutorials/assets/energy_trajectory_2x2_pbc.png --title "Square Heisenberg 2x2 PBC D=2: robust SR, fixed Sz=0" --ref-energy -4.0 --ref-label exact
